## Detailed Project Case Studies

### 1. OctaLume IoT Dashboard
- **Role**: Lead Product Designer & Frontend Developer (Designed & Developed)
- **Category**: Industrial IoT, Smart Energy & Telemetry Dashboards
- **Overview**: An enterprise IoT control panel for municipal smart streetlighting and power management across multiple cities. Features real-time energy telemetry, automated fault alerts, schedule planning, and visual map controls.
- **Key Deliverables**: Design System, Interactive Prototypes, React Dashboard UI, Telemetry Charts, Dark Mode Glassmorphic UI.

### 2. UF Brand E-Commerce Platform
- **Role**: Product Designer & Developer (Designed & Developed)
- **Category**: E-Commerce, Fashion & Retail
- **Overview**: A modern, high-converting e-commerce web platform for UF Brand ethnic wear. Focused on seamless product discovery, editorial visuals, mobile-first responsive shopping, and frictionless checkout.
- **Key Deliverables**: UX Research, Information Architecture, E-Commerce UI Components, Product Catalog, Responsive Front-End.

### 3. Multi-City Travel Planner
- **Role**: UI/UX Designer & Developer (Designed & Developed)
- **Category**: Travel Tech, Web App & Productivity
- **Overview**: An intuitive travel planning web application that allows users to plan multi-city itineraries, organize day-by-day activities, track transit logistics, and collaborate in real-time.
- **Key Deliverables**: User Flow Diagrams, Interactive Maps & Timeline Controls, Component Architecture, Responsive Web App.

### 4. Pickcel Marketing Website & Console Redesign
- **Role**: Lead UI/UX Designer & Frontend Strategist (Designed & Developed)
- **Category**: SaaS, Marketing Website & Enterprise Cloud Software
- **Overview**: Redesign of Pickcel's cloud digital signage platform website and SaaS management console. Modernized the brand identity, simplified navigation, and created conversion-focused landing pages.
- **Key Deliverables**: Landing Page Redesign, SaaS Dashboard UI, Design Tokens, Interactive Demos.

### 5. ThinkStack AI Platform
- **Role**: Product Designer & Frontend Engineer (Designed & Developed)
- **Category**: Artificial Intelligence, AI Orchestration & Developer Tools
- **Overview**: An enterprise AI platform interface for orchestrating LLM agents, monitoring API performance, and building automated AI workflows.
- **Key Deliverables**: Developer Console UI, Flow Graph Canvas, Dark Mode UI Components, Design System Documentation.

## Core Expertise & Technical Capabilities

- **Product Design**: User Research, User Journeys, Wireframing, High-Fidelity UI, Interactive Prototyping, Usability Testing.
- **Design Systems**: Token Architecture, Figma Variants, Reusable React Component Libraries, Style Guides, Auto-Layout Systems.
- **Frontend Development**: React.js, Vanilla JS, HTML5, Vanilla CSS, Webpack/Vite, Responsive Layouts.
- **Motion & Interactions**: GSAP (GreenSock), Lenis Smooth Scroll, CSS Animations, WebGL 3D (Three.js).
- **AI-Paired Workflow**: Leveraging Figma + AI Agents to accelerate prototyping, code implementation, and iteration cycles.
